specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: The AMS has 4 filament slots, each filament slot has its own motor and gears to actively push the filament forward or wind it back to the spool.
specs.note: Agrees with the store page description ("Each Bambu Lab AMS is composed of 4 filament slots"), which the package does not parse into a row.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: H2 Series AMS Connection Guide › Cable Connection
specs.quote: Each AMS has two 6-pin ports on the back, allowing you to daisy-chain multiple AMS units.
specs.note: The guide defines "AMS" as the AMS (first generation), AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT together. The same section: "6-pin cables are required to connect AMS to 3D printer for power and communication". The guide also notes the cable supplied with the AMS has a 1.1 mm step height (2.5 mm for AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT); no registry key holds it.

specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: when using AMS, please note that the ambient temperature must be maintained at 10-30 ℃ and the humidity must be less than 85%.
specs.note: The same sentence requires humidity below 85%; no registry key for humidity applies to the ams type (part.humidity is parts-only).

specs.source_title: AMS main functions and workflow introduction | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: AMS feeding system introduction › Filament hub
specs.quote: The odometer is used to determine whether the filament has been sent out of the AMS, and can also be used to calculate the length of the filament sent out.
specs.note: The X1 manual page describes the same part as "one magnetic rotary encoder" in the Filaments Hub.

specs.source_title: AMS main functions and workflow introduction | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: The main functions of AMS › Filament run-out detection and auto-refill function
specs.quote: When you use AMS printing, it still has the filament run-out detection function
specs.note: Each filament slot also has a sensor to detect the filament (X1 manual, "Filament Slot"). Agrees with the store page feature bullet "Filament Runout & Winding Detection".

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System: store page
specs.quote: When the filament at the toolhead encounters resistance, it may be that the filament is tangled or the spool is stuck, AMS can detect it immediately and suspend printing
specs.note: Store page prose only, so unverified. The connection guide attributes tangle detection to the filament buffer ("The filament buffer assists with feeding filament from the AMS to the printer by adjusting the feeding speed and detecting filament tangles"), which the store page lists in the box but which X1/P1 setups must otherwise buy separately.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: A1 Series Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
specs.quote: Supports up to 4 AMS units (AMS, AMS 2 Pro, or AMS HT) connected at the same time. You can mix these models in any combination.
specs.test_condition: A1 series: up to 4 AMS units in total (AMS, AMS 2 Pro or AMS HT, any mix), through the A1 series AMS Hub
specs.note: Agrees with the A1 Series variant description ("A1 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS HT, AMS, AMS 2 Pro).").

specs.source_title: Introduction to AMS | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: The AMS Hub replaces the filament Buffer. It allows the user to connect four AMS units, which in turn can supply 16 different filament spools to the printer.
specs.test_condition: X1/P1 series, through the AMS Hub: 4 units in total (AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT counted together)
specs.note: The connection guide adds "The X1/P1 supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro or 4 AMS HT units — 4 units in total."; the X1/P1 variant descriptions say "up to 4 AMS units (including AMS HT, AMS, AMS 2 Pro)". All agree.

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System: store page
specs.quote: P2S printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 4 AMS HT units.
specs.test_condition: P2S: AMS and AMS 2 Pro counted together; plus up to 4 AMS HT units
specs.note: The connection guide row names the second-generation units only ("The P2S supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro and 4 AMS HT units simultaneously — 8 units in total with 20 slots."); the store text names the AMS (first generation) explicitly, so it is the source.

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System: store page
specs.quote: H2 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units (including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 8 AMS HT units.
specs.test_condition: H2S: AMS and AMS 2 Pro counted together; plus up to 8 AMS HT units
specs.note: The connection guide row names the second-generation units only ("Supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro units and 8 AMS HT units connected simultaneously."); the store text names the AMS (first generation) explicitly, so it is the source.

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System: store page
specs.quote: H2 series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units(including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 8 AMS HT units .
specs.test_condition: H2D/H2C: AMS and AMS 2 Pro counted together; plus up to 8 AMS HT units
specs.note: The connection guide row names the second-generation units only ("Supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro units and 8 AMS HT units connected simultaneously."); the store text names the AMS (first generation) explicitly, so it is the source.

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System: store page
specs.quote: X2D series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units(including AMS, AMS 2 Pro) and 8 AMS HT units.
specs.test_condition: X2D: AMS and AMS 2 Pro counted together; plus up to 8 AMS HT units
specs.note: The connection guide row names the second-generation units only ("Supports up to 4 AMS 2 Pro and 8 AMS HT units simultaneously."); the store text names the AMS (first generation) explicitly, so it is the source.

specs.source_title: Connection Guide for Multiple AMS Units with Different Printer Models | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: A2L Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
specs.quote: Supports up to 4 AMS units and 1 AMS lite simultaneously
specs.test_condition: A2L: up to 4 AMS units (AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT counted together) plus 1 AMS lite
specs.note: The guide uses "AMS" for the AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT together. Agrees with the A2 Series variant descriptions ("A2L series printer can connect up to 4 AMS units(including AMS, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT) and 1 AMS lite.").

relations.locator: A1 Series Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
relations.quote: Supports up to 4 AMS units (AMS, AMS 2 Pro, or AMS HT) connected at the same time.
relations.note: Needs the A1 series AMS Hub and printer firmware 01.07.00.00 or later.

relations.locator: X1/P1 Series Connection Guide › Accessories required
relations.quote: When connecting 1 AMS to the X1/P1 series printer, you need to purchase a Filament Buffer , a PTFE Tube Coupler , and a 4-pin Cable separately.

relations.locator: X1/P1 Series Connection Guide › Accessories required
relations.quote: When connecting 1 AMS to the X1/P1 series printer, you need to purchase a Filament Buffer , a PTFE Tube Coupler , and a 4-pin Cable separately.

relations.locator: P2S › Accessories required
relations.quote: When pairing a standalone P2S with a standalone AMS, you also need to purchase a P2S filament buffer .

relations.locator: H2 Series AMS Connection Guide › PTFE Tube Connection
relations.quote: When connecting two AMS units to the H2S, a 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter is also required.
relations.note: The H2 series filament buffer is built in.

relations.locator: H2 Series AMS Connection Guide
relations.quote: The connection method for AMS with H2D and H2C is the same.
relations.note: The H2 series filament buffer is built in.

relations.locator: H2 Series AMS Connection Guide
relations.quote: The connection method for AMS with H2D and H2C is the same.
relations.note: The H2 series filament buffer is built in.

relations.locator: X2D Printer Connection Guide
relations.quote: Accessory Required: Scenarios with more than two AMS units require purchasing the 4-in-1 PTFE adapter II .

relations.locator: A2L Connection Guide › Accessories required
relations.quote: When connecting a single AMS to the A2L, no additional accessories are required
relations.note: A single AMS connects through the PTFE tube coupler included in the A2L tool kit.

relations.locator: A1 Series Connection Guide › Maximum number of connected AMS units
relations.quote: Alternatively, you can connect one AMS lite — but the AMS lite cannot be combined with other AMS models.
relations.note: On the A1 series only: the AMS lite and this AMS cannot be connected at the same time. The A2L takes 4 AMS units and 1 AMS lite together.

relations.locator: A1 Series Connection Guide › Accessories required
relations.quote: To connect AMS, AMS 2 Pro, or AMS HT, an A Series AMS Hub are required, which should be purchased seperately.
relations.note: The guide also warns: "Do not use the filament buffer or AMS Hub included with the AMS to connect an A series printer to the AMS."

relations.note: For the H2D. The H2C needs the H2 series dedicated version (see the next relation).

relations.target_label: H2 Series Dedicated 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter (4-in-1 PTFE Adapter II, SA014)

scope.value_text: H2D/H2C / Connect 3 or more AMS units / AMS

relations.note: H2C only. The store page words it as a recommendation ("For better performance, we recommend 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter II (SA014) for H2C."). No manifest product is this adapter, so the target is unresolved.

relations.note: CONFLICT for review: the same guide says the X2D needs the standard adapter ("the P2S and X2D requires the standard 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter") and, in the X2D section, "the 4-in-1 PTFE adapter II"; the store X2D variant says "To connect 3 or more AMS units, a PTFE Tube Coupler(FAZ006) is required." (the package writes requires PTFE Tube Coupler from it).
